status: Protocol fixed before external error computation; endpoint and license review required before launch
models: fixed random forest baseline trained only on AqSolDB train_val
primary_prediction: Mean of five per-seed predictions for each frozen ensemble; identical aggregation for both. Distinct from the TDC five-run mean MAE.

baseline.representation: 210 RDKit descriptors with original deterministic failure-to-zero policy
baseline.training: All train_val rows, no external labels, no tuning

cohort: Water SMILES O; 297.15–299.15 K inclusive; all AqSolDB structures excluded under parent/neutral/tautomer/stereo-insensitive matching; conservative heavy-element composition exclusion for failed reference structure; exclude fingerprint Tanimoto 1.0 versus train_val
units: Use supplied LogS(mol/L), not log mole fraction; no new unit conversion. Missing/nonfinite labels excluded with counts after label access. Published conversion approximations must be disclosed.
aggregation: For each standardized parent, first median across rows per Source, then median across sources. Predictions use each unique raw SMILES once and are averaged within parent. No selective solid-form filtering after errors.
metrics: paired MAE difference vs predecessor and RF
uncertainty: 2000 paired molecule bootstrap resamples, fixed RNG 20261026; percentile 95% intervals. Source dependence remains a limitation.
subsets: Prespecified nearest-training Tanimoto below 0.3, 0.3–0.6, and >=0.6; descriptive counts and MAE, no subgroup tuning.
one_shot: Save all model predictions and hashes before loading targets for scoring; exclusive started marker; preserve all results, never choose weights or dataset based on external errors.
limitations: Most rows have no solid-form label
Different literature sources and conditions; external transfer evaluation, not universally clean intrinsic-solubility test
